result.question: Where did the leaders in the tower of Shechem enter?

readings.answer: the inner chamber of the temple of El-berith
readings.support: the inner chamber of the temple of El-berith

assessments.reason: It exactly matches Judges 9:46: “all the leaders in the tower of Shechem entered the inner chamber of the temple of El-berith.”

result.reason: Verse 9:46 explicitly states they entered the inner chamber of the temple of El-berith.
